incidents.text: Mahmoud Abunada (Qatar) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
Breel Embolo (Switzerland) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
Goal! Breel Embolo (Switzerland) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mahmoud Abunada to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
The referee is firm and issues Jassem Gaber (Qatar) a deserved yellow card.
Denis Zakaria (Switzerland) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ayoub Al Oui trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ahmed Fathi (Qatar).
Julen Lopetegui has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Karim Boudiaf (Qatar) replacing Jassem Gaber.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ahmed Alaaeldin (Qatar) comes onto the pitch for Yusuf Abdurisag.
We are about to witness a substitution. Johan Manzambi (Switzerland) is replacing Dan Ndoye.
Murat Yakin prepares a substitution. Michel Aebischer is replaced by Fabian Rieder (Switzerland).
Substitution. Mohammad Al Mannai (Qatar) has come on for Assim Omer Madibo.
Murat Yakin has decided to make a change. Zeki Amdouni (Switzerland) replaces Ruben Vargas.
A substitution has been made. Edmilson Junior is replaced by Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar).
Here is a change. Ricardo Rodriguez is going off and Murat Yakin gives the last tactical orders to Miro Muheim (Switzerland).
Substitution. Remo Freuler did his best and is replaced by Ardon Jashari (Switzerland).
It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Miro Muheim (Switzerland), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but heads the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:1.
